Chapter 6704: Prime Lotus Flame

Chapter 6704: Prime Lotus Flame

This was both an agreement and a transaction. Some could say Bao Pu and the ghost benefited the most, gaining the redemption grounds’ resources and primordial flesh.

Bao Pu became a complete immortal while the ghost became something just as mighty. Their spoils couldn’t be overstated. However, they found themselves to be pawns all of a sudden.

This was the desired outcome of the primordial immortals and they were chosen as the perfect candidates. Weizhen was the key since he mediated everything.

Although both were furious, they couldn’t change anything. After all, they got their spoils; it was just that they thought they were the masterminds, not tools.

Now, they have exposed themselves and were hunted by Desolate Ancestor. They could sense the disdain from the two primordial immortals and Weizhen as well. Alas, they needed to focus on getting out alive.

Meanwhile, Li Qiye smiled at the two beings and smiled: “How does it feel?”

“Perfection, I can’t ask for more in this lifetime. Thank you.” Evil Transformation bowed.

“We spent half of our lives in the swamp, not knowing anything. Once we found out, we struggled and couldn’t reach the shore. Now, we are finally shore-touched.” Fiendish Ground enjoyed this feeling.

“I didn’t give it to you two, this is part of the agreement.” Li Qiye said.

“We must thank our older brother as well. He left his shored shell in this world and gave us this chance. How embarrassing, we once thought our primordial shell was the greatest, the finest of all. In reality, it’s a pile of mud compared to the shore.” Evil Transformation smiled.

“No opportunity to thank him.” Fiendish Ground said: “Virtuous Nephew, we do owe you for this. If you survive, let our brother know that we appreciate him.”

Both gained the presence of the high heaven and the mentality of the shore realm. Their older brother was none other than Taichu’s master, or that person.

Calling him “older brother” was accurate. That person might not be the firstborn among the thirty-six primordial immortals. However, he was the first to leave and reach the shore.

He shed his perfect body at the shore stage and hid it in the primordial tree.

“This is your fortune, Seniors, I dare not take credit for this.” Taichu shook his head: “Although I knew a little and speculated more, I did not understand my master’s intent.”

His master didn’t tell Taichu or anyone else about his body being stored in the primordial tree. Taichu had suspected something like this but didn’t know the location.

The primordial tree shouldered three thousand worlds. Thus, although he had control over it, he still couldn’t find it.

However, Fiendish Ground and Evil Transformation found it because it was meant for them. Of course, all of this required Li Qiye’s permission.

Therefore, they came here to fulfill their part of the bargain instead of disappearing or running. Keep in mind they could have done so easily - leaving Three Immortals World for Heaven Realm or any other minor world.

They gained the ability to hide from the high heaven with their new form. Alas, they were here to fight Li Qiye to the death.

“Prime Lotus Flame, creator of tribulations.” Li Qiye remarked while staring at the deepest part of the two figures.

“Master knew you would understand him, Sacred Teacher.” Taichu became startled.

“Prime Lotus Flame is a good name. It does give off that impression at first sight.” Fiendish Ground said.

“It can birth the high heaven, this body is so close to being one.” Evil Transformation laughed.

“That’s the goal, to replace the high heaven.” Li Qiye nodded.

“I see.” Both became emotional. That person’s physique was clearly above their primordial shells.

As for overlords and lower-realm cultivators, they thought no one could replace the imperious high heaven. Now, someone had a physique ready to do so. This must be a terrifying being, potentially a second high heaven.
